## Description

A payment against the invoice settles the oldest open instalment first. Overdue instalments show on the dues list and send a balance reminder with no clinical detail. The plan closes when paid or is cancelled with a reason.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Reminders respect the patient's consent and carry no clinical detail.
- [ ] **AC2.** Cancelling a plan returns the remaining balance to ordinary dues.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
